name: service_cases_list
description: List service cases, optionally filtered by status, issue type, region, product, owner or account (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+FROM+Case).

status.description: Case status: open, escalated, pending_customer or closed.

issue_type.description: Issue type label from the issue taxonomy.

region.description: Service region the case belongs to.

product_code.description: Product the case was filed against.

owner_employee_id.description: Employee id of the case owner.

priority.description: Case priority: low, medium, high or critical.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
